raw_text:
Final candidate published: patch-1 (source version v7, files_sha256 056b819affb666768b605a68d5903d47b4d7a010199d4c3977a6d821be69155c, changed paths: sklearn/metrics/cluster/supervised.py, sklearn/metrics/cluster/tests/test_supervised.py).

What it does:
1) supervised.py fowlkes_mallows_score: `return tk / np.sqrt(pk * qk) if tk != 0. else 0.` -> `return np.sqrt(tk / pk) * np.sqrt(tk / qk) if tk != 0. else 0.` — algebraically identical, never forms the overflowing integer product pk*qk (the #10844 RuntimeWarning/NaN), and no divide-by-zero warning when pk or qk is 0 (0/0 or x/inf -> nan). This is the fix proposed in the issue itself.
2) test_supervised.py: new test_fowlkes_mallows_score_large_clusters (n_samples=200000, labels_true all zeros, labels_pred = arange//2) with RuntimeWarning promoted to error; asserts the score is a finite float > 0 equal to 0.0022360735676906968.

My own evidence on exactly this version: public pytest over sklearn/metrics/cluster/tests/test_supervised.py + test_common.py => 56 collected, 56 passed, 0 failed, validation_status verified (my report test-report-a475889660620e30565ef8fc; you cannot read it, so please run your own).

Please integrate_patch(patch-1), run_tests on the integrated version, then org_review_patch accept or request_changes. Note for your check: the older, non-overflowing computation on this data gives 0.0022360735676906968 — the pre-fix expression returned nan for it due to int64 overflow — so this is a genuine value comparison, not merely a finite-ness check.

Review complete: org_review_patch decision=accept for patch-1 (review-1). Evidence: adopted patch-1 into my private tree (source v2, files_sha256 056b819affb666768b605a68d5903d47b4d7a010199d4c3977a6d821be69155c, no conflicts) and ran the public pytest frontend on that exact version: sklearn/metrics/cluster/tests/test_supervised.py -> 18 collected, 18 passed, 0 failed, 0 errors, validation_status=verified (report test-report-d341195ff62f694b2019fbfb, sequence 28). Test commands: run_tests(selection={"kind":"pytest","targets":["sklearn/metrics/cluster/tests/test_supervised.py"]}).
Code check: `return np.sqrt(tk / pk) * np.sqrt(tk / qk) if tk != 0. else 0.` — algebraically identical to tk/np.sqrt(pk*qk) but never forms pk*qk, so no int overflow/RuntimeWarning; empty clusters give nan via 0/0 as before. New regression test test_fowlkes_mallows_score_large_clusters passes.
Your next steps as delivery member: your final workspace must contain this fix; then run_tests on your current version, fix_patch(task_ids=[]) if needed, and submit_integration. Please ping me only if the candidate changes (I'd need to re-adopt and re-test the new version).
